entries.name: AddonSwap
entries.description: For Terran only, swap 3x3 structures. Pass in two structures and they will swap positions.

params.name: structure_needing_addon
params.description: The structure type we want the addon for.

params.name: addon_required
params.description: Type of addon required.

params.name: precise_addon_structure_id
params.description: Precise addon structure id.

entries.name: AutoSupply
entries.description: Automatically build supply, works for all races.

params.name: base_location
params.description: The base location where supply should be built.

params.name: return_true_if_supply_required
params.description: If supply can't be afforded but is required, return true. Useful for creating a `MacroPlan`.

params.name: closest_to
params.description: Find available supply placement closest to this location. Only applicable to Terran or Protoss.

entries.name: BuildStructure
entries.description: Handy convenience building structure behavior. Especially combined with `Mining` and ares built in placement solver. Finds an ideal mining worker, and an available precalculated placement. Then removes worker from mining records and provides a new role.

params.name: base_location
params.description: The base location to build near.

params.name: structure_id
params.description: The structure type we want to build.

params.name: max_on_route
params.description: The max number of workers on route to build this. Defaults to 1.

params.name: first_pylon
params.description: Will look for the first pylon in placements dict. Defaults to False.

params.name: static_defence
params.description: Will look for static defense in placements dict. Defaults to False.

params.name: wall
params.description: Find wall placement if possible. Only the main base is currently supported. Defaults to False.

params.name: closest_to
params.description: Find placement at this base closest to the given point. Optional.

params.name: to_count
params.description: Prevent going over this amount in total. Defaults to 0, turning this check off.

params.name: to_count_per_base
params.description: Prevent going over this amount at this base location. Defaults to 0, turning this check off.

params.name: tech_progress_check
params.description: Check if tech is ready before trying to build. Defaults to 0.85; setting it to 0.0 turns this check off.

params.name: supply_depot
params.description: Choose a predefined supply depot location. Defaults to False.

params.name: missile_turret
params.description: Choose a predefined missile turret location. Defaults to False.

params.name: sensor_tower
params.description: Choose a predefined sensor tower location. Defaults to False.

params.name: upgrade_structure
params.description: Choose a predefined upgrade-structure location. Defaults to False.

params.name: production
params.description: Choose a predefined production location. Defaults to True.

params.name: bunker
params.description: Choose a predefined bunker location. Defaults to False.

params.name: reaper_wall
params.description: Choose a predefined reaper wall location. Defaults to False.

params.name: find_alternative
params.description: If no placements are available at this base, optionally search nearby bases. Defaults to True.

entries.name: BuildWorkers
entries.description: Finds idle townhalls / larvae and build workers.

params.name: to_count
params.description: The target count of workers we want to hit.

params.name: to_count
params.description: The target base count.

params.name: can_afford_check
params.description: Check if we can afford expansion. Setting this to False will allow the worker to move to a location ready to build the expansion. Defaults to True.

params.name: check_location_is_safe
params.description: Check if we don't knowingly expand at a dangerous location. Defaults to True.

params.name: max_pending
params.description: Maximum pending townhalls at any time. Defaults to 1.

params.name: prioritize
params.description: Will return True for this behavior if we can't afford expansion. Default is False

entries.name: GasBuildingController
entries.description: Maintain gas building count. Finds an ideal mining worker, and an available geyser. Then removes worker from mining records and provides a new role.

params.name: to_count
params.description: How many gas buildings would we like?

params.name: max_pending
params.description: How many gas buildings can be pending at any time? Defaults to 1.

params.name: closest_to
params.description: Find available geyser closest to this location. Optional, defaults to `None`

entries.name: MacroPlan

params.name: macros
params.description: A list of behaviors that should be executed. Defaults to an empty list.

entries.llm_exposure_reason: Contains nested behaviors and needs a dedicated composition instruction shape.

params.name: flee_at_health_perc
params.description: If worker is in danger, at what health percentage should it flee? Defaults to 0.5.

params.name: keep_safe
params.description: Should workers flee if they are in danger? Defaults to True.

params.name: long_distance_mine
params.description: Can the worker long distance mine if it has nothing to do? Defaults to True.

params.name: mineral_boost
params.description: Turn mineral boosting on or off. Defaults to True.

params.name: vespene_boost
params.description: Turn vespene boosting on or off (only active when workers_per_gas < 3).

params.name: workers_per_gas
params.description: Control how many workers are assigned to each gas. Defaults to 3.

params.name: self_defence_active
params.description: If set to True, workers will have some basic defence. Certain workers will attack enemy in range. Defaults to True.

params.name: safe_long_distance_mineral_fields
params.description: Used internally, set when a worker starts long distance mining. Defaults to None.

params.name: locked_action_tags
params.description: Locked action tags.

params.name: weight_safety_limit
params.description: Workers will flee if enemy influence is above this number. Defaults to 12.0

entries.name: ProductionController
entries.description: Handle creating extra production facilities based on an army composition dictionary. This dictionary should be structured the same as the one passed into SpawnController

params.name: army_composition_dict
params.description: A dictionary detailing how an army composition should be made up. The proportional values should all add up to 1.0, with a priority integer for unit emphasis.

params.name: base_location
params.description: The location where production should be built.

params.name: add_production_at_bank
params.description: When the bank reaches this size, calculate what extra production would be useful. Tuple: minerals, then vespene. Defaults to `(400, 400)`.

params.name: alpha
params.description: Controls how much production to add when the bank is higher than `add_production_at_bank`. Defaults to `0.9`.

params.name: unit_pending_progress
params.description: Count production structures that are nearly complete before adding more. Defaults to `0.75`.

params.name: ignore_below_proportion
params.description: Accepted for API compatibility; currently ignored by the implementation.

params.name: should_repower_structures
params.description: Search for unpowered structures and build a new pylon if needed. Defaults to `True`.

params.name: max_production_structures
params.description: Stop adding production at this number Defaults to 12

entries.name: ProtossStaticDefence
entries.description: Build protoss static defence at all bases with a Nexus.

params.name: pylons_per_base
params.description: Number of pylons to maintain per base.

params.name: photon_cannons_per_base
params.description: Number of photon cannons to maintain per base.

params.name: shield_batteries_per_base
params.description: Number of shield batteries to maintain per base.

params.name: exclude_base_locations
params.description: Base locations to skip when placing defence.

params.name: max_on_route
params.description: Max number of workers on route per structure type.

params.name: tech_base_location
params.description: Where to build tech requirements (forge/core).

entries.llm_exposure_reason: Requires review because it is not listed by the current documentation chapter.

params.name: army_composition_dict
params.description: A dictionary detailing how an army composition should be made up. The proportional values should all add up to 1.0, with a priority integer for unit emphasis.

params.name: freeflow_mode
params.description: If set to True, army composition proportions are ignored, and resources will be spent freely. Defaults to `False`.

params.name: ignore_proportions_below_unit_count
params.description: In early game, units affect the army proportions significantly. This allows some units to be freely built before proportions are respected. Defaults to `0`.

params.name: over_produce_on_low_tech
params.description: If only one tech is available for a unit, this allows that unit to be constantly produced. Defaults to `True`.

params.name: ignored_build_from_tags
params.description: A set of tags to prevent the spawn controller from morphing from these tags.

params.name: maximum
params.description: The maximum number of a unit type that can be produced in a single step. Defaults to `20`.

params.name: spawn_target
params.description: A location to prioritize spawning units near. Defaults to `None`.

params.name: __build_dict
params.description: build dict.

params.name: __excluded_structure_tags
params.description: excluded structure tags.

params.name: __supply_available
params.description: supply available.

entries.name: SpeedMining
entries.description: Speed mine worker at provided townhall and target resource.

params.name: worker
params.description: The worker to mine with.

params.name: target
params.description: The resource to mine.

params.name: worker_position
params.description: Position of worker.

params.name: resource_target_pos
params.description: Position in front or resource to move to before queueing a mine command.

params.name: distance_to_townhall_factor
params.description: How far away from th to move command. Default is 1.08

params.name: townhall
params.description: Townhall worker is assigned to. Default to None (will calculate closest if so)

entries.name: TechUp
entries.description: Automatically tech up so desired upgrade/unit can be built.

params.name: desired_tech
params.description: The desired upgrade or unit type.

params.name: base_location
params.description: The main building location to make tech.

params.name: ignore_existing_techlabs
params.description: If set to `True`, will keep building techlabs even if others exist. Defaults to `False`.

entries.name: UpgradeCCs
entries.description: Upgrade an idle Terran Command Center to an Orbital Command or Planetary Fortress.

params.name: to
params.description: The desired Command Center upgrade: ORBITALCOMMAND or PLANETARYFORTRESS.

params.name: prioritize
params.description: If True and there is a CC waiting to upgrade, but we can't afford it yet, this behavior will return True This is useful in a MacroPlan as it will prevent other spending actions occurring. Default is False

entries.llm_exposure_reason: Reviewed for the BC Rush IM contract despite source-only documentation status.

entries.name: UpgradeController
entries.description: Research upgrades, if the upgrade is not currently researchable this behavior will automatically make the tech buildings required.

params.name: upgrade_list
params.description: List of desired upgrades.

params.name: base_location
params.description: Location to build upgrade buildings.

params.name: auto_tech_up_enabled
params.description: Whether to automatically build missing tech structures required for the requested upgrade. Defaults to True.

params.name: prioritize
params.description: If True and there is an Upgrade ready to go, but we can't afford it yet, this behavior will return True. This is useful in a MacroPlan as it will prevent other spending actions occurring. Default is False
